gold_liquidity_analysis: XAUUSD experienced a sharp sweep of intraday liquidity down to the session low of 3600.5, tapping key psychological round number support before printing a rejection wick on the 15m timeframe. DXY has simultaneously softened toward 103.85, providing a constructive macro tailwind for a mean reversion bounce on Gold.
trade_thesis: Institutional absorption detected at the 3600-3602 level following a aggressive cascading selloff. Price has swept weak longs, clearing stops and opening an asymmetric long opportunity targeting a recovery back toward the 3620-3622 value area.
